messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-15T14:02:12Z — stream-gen-us-west: sustained latency spike. p95=740ms (SLO=500ms), p99=2.3s (SLO=1.5s). Error-rate stable but streaming stalls observed. ~18% sessions impacted. Auto-fallback to model-small-quant triggered but tail latency persists.

monitoring-bot: Related metrics: cpu_util ~72%, gpu_util inconsistent across host gpu-az-west-14, corrected_ecc_count increased on same host.

eva (oncall): Acknowledged. I'm taking lead. Paging infra/runtime. @marcos @sree please join now. Kelly, prepare a short holding note for customers (ETA 30m).

marcos (infra): On it. Running quick NVML/KVM probe against gpu-az-west-14. Suspect intermittent ECC-correctable surge + fan oscillation. Starting live probe now.

sree (runtime): I see requests queued in the streaming box at the same time as repeated kernel reinitializations (same sequence length). Repro pipeline shows streaming stalls after ~1.8k tokens. Will attach traces.

marcos (infra): nvml excerpt: ```
GPU 0: Tesla-X (UUID: GPU-az-14)
  Temperature: 83 C
  Fan Speed: 67 % (fluctuating)
  ECC Corrected Errors: 124 -> 314 (last 15m)
  Power Draw: 180W
  ECC Uncorrectable: 0
```

marcos (infra): Also checked dmesg on host: ```
[ 1234.567890] nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: Corrected ECC error on GPU 0
[ 1234.568012] nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: GPU reset due to link flake
[ 1236.001245] nv_peer_mem: warning: peer memory flucuation detected
```

eva (oncall): Good data. Sree, can we route new streaming sessions off that host to the warm pool? Need graceful migration to avoid user-visible failures.

sree (runtime): Yes. Initiating routing rule to divert new sessions away from gpu-az-west-14 and enable aggressive KV prefix caching for in-flight sessions to reduce tail work. Command: `rctl route set --exclude-host gpu-az-west-14 --service stream-gen-us-west`

sree (runtime): Also triggered runtime fallback policy: fallback-to-small-quant for requests with expected 1.5k+ token horizon. That should lower p99 for new sessions.

marcos (infra): I'm marking the node as 'draining' in the scheduler, will coordinate live-evacuate for active streams. Evac is slow because of long-lived sessions; doing connection handover in 10s windows.

kelly (support): Draft holding message for affected customers: "We're investigating elevated streaming latency in US-West. Some long sessions may experience stalls; we're routing traffic and mitigating. We'll update in 30 minutes." Want to run by Jordan for copy.

jordan (product): Fine. Add that we're prioritizing low-latency traffic and that an RCA will follow. Keep it short.

eva (oncall): Triage update (10m): After routing exclusions and fallback, p95 dropped to 520ms, p99 to ~1.6s — still above target but improving. Impacted session % down to ~6%. Continuing evacuation of gpu-az-west-14.

sree (runtime): Observed repeated kernel init stack traces in runtime logs — looks like NVML retries -> driver reset loop causing stalls. Snippet: ```
[runtime] kernel_init(): loading attention-optimized kernels
[driver] nv_reset(): recovered but session stalled -> KV cache miss -> recompile
```

marcos (infra): Fan profile has rapid oscillation. I triggered a maintenance override: set fan to 90% on host to stabilize temps. Also flagged the node for hardware swap if behavior persists after cooling.

monitoring-bot: Alert suppressed: routing change detected. Keep an eye on corrected ECC counter.

eva (oncall): Temporary mitigation: routing + fan override + fallback reduced user-visible stalls. Next steps: 1) Continue evacuation and observe for 30m; 2) If ECC corrected errors continue increasing, schedule node out-of-band replacement; 3) Post-incident RCA.

marcos (infra): I'm running a stress probe on a spare card to reproduce behavior; will also request vendor diagnostics and an RMA if we can repro.

kelly (support): Customer update ready. Posting in status page now and pinging 3 largest affected customers with ETA.

jordan (product): Monitor feature flags for streaming that might exacerbate long token runs; consider temporary throttle for >2k token sessions during recovery window.

eva (oncall): Handoff at 14:45 UTC to night oncall @sree for monitoring. I'll remain reachable. Please add any new findings here. Final note: no uncorrectable ECC yet, but corrected errors spiked — treat as precursor to hardware failure.

marcos (infra): Confirmed — moving node to quarantine after all active streams finish migration. Will attach vendor ticket #VEND-3241 in the incident doc.

sree (runtime): Saved trace links and dump: https://artifacts.internal/trace/4321098765. If anyone needs immediate rollback knobs: `rctl fallback disable` and `rctl route reset`.

kelly (support): Posted support notes and shared customer list with ops.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress, severity lowered. Monitoring for recurrence.

-- end thread --
